Post 1

📉 Tech crushed the ASX today. The index slipped 16.20pts to 9,053.80 (-0.18%), crossing below its 20-day MA — but the real damage was in tech stocks. Five-day loss now sits at 1.69%. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

IT sector dropped 3.15% — the session's clear loser. Health Care surged 2.60%, offsetting the drag. A-REITs fell 1.15% despite property names jumping. Sector rotation in full swing. #ASX #healthcare #ausbiz

Post 3

🔺 SGP (Stockland) was the session's shock winner — up 12.35% to AUD 4.55. That's a massive single-day move for a large-cap REIT, contrasting sharply with the broader A-REIT sector's 1.15% decline. #ASX #property

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 6,164.54/oz. Silver AUD 89.82/oz. AUD/USD sits at 0.7062. Metals pricing in AUD terms remains elevated — currency moves matter here. #gold #silver #ausbiz #commodities

Post 5

ASX sits 2.61% below its 52-week high. Watch whether tech stabilises — WTC lost 8.70% today alone. Can Health Care's 2.60% gain hold the index above 9,000? Where do you see support? #ASX #ausbiz
